comment: THE DUNGEON RIFT TEST PATH (sl-0180 wave 2): the designer's shape verbatim - 'a 1-5 min long path... you walk through it like a path with enemy mobs scattered along the way and a boss at the end'. 64x44 serpentine: five 4-wide legs joined by end shafts, ~280 path tiles (~78 s pure walk at 3.6 t/s; fights + the boss land the run mid-band). Pack spacing under the WARREN DISTANCE-DISCIPLINE LAW (aggro is euclidean and walls do not block it): every pack >12 t from the previous pack's fight zone, script-verified at authoring (min separation 14.4). The boss room (16x9, wider than the one-room rift) holds the pool's decel_wall at the far end; the flee door sits at the mouth (2,3). Galaxy skin rides view-side (rift_view backdrop); quiet dark floor (Law 6).
